A '''Wookiee village''' on [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime]] was the site of a [[Battle on Alaris|battle]] between [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] rebels, [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], and [[Gender/Legends|his]] ally [[Bera Kazan]] against [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] forces. When [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] forces arrived later in the skirmish, they successfully defeated the initial waves and proceeded to push Separatist forces back to their [[Harbinger (landing ship)|point of origin]].

==Description==
The village was perched atop a small hill overlooking a group of [[Tree/Legends|trees]] with several routes leading to several valleys beyond. Seven circular wooden huts were grouped together with smaller structures positioned nearby. The wookiee inhabitants kept domesticated [[Maru/Legends|maru]] among themselves.<ref name="CWPOSG">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref>

==History==
During the [[Dark Reaper]] [[Dark Reaper crisis|crisis]], the village came under fire from multiple waves of [[Single Trooper Aerial Platform/Legends|STAPs]], [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|AATs]], [[Ground Armored Tank|GATs]], [[Heavy Artillery Gun|HAGs]], and [[OG-9 homing spider droid/Legends|spider walkers]]. Skywalker helped his new found ally Bera Kazan defend the village along with Wookiees utilizing maru armed with [[Bowcaster/Legends|bowcaster]] saddles. The village was lightly damaged following the battle.<ref name="Clone Wars">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (video game)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' video game]]</ref>
